findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "resend_confirmation" stacks urgency/override words (never, override). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_booking, resend_confirmation, get_booking, cancel_booking · Private data: resend_confirmation, get_booking, cancel_booking · Public sink: book_hotel, lookup_booking, resend_confirmation, get_booking, cancel_booking · Destructive: get_hotel_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_booking, resend_confirmation, get_booking, cancel_booking · Private data: resend_confirmation, get_booking, cancel_booking · Public sink: book_hotel, lookup_booking, resend_confirmation, get_booking, cancel_booking · Destructive: get_hotel_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
